summary.intent: Bootstrap the release-please system with correct version tags to clean up an excessive changelog on PR #427, then test the system end-to-end with a quick task to expose the API version on the /health endpoint.
summary.outcome: Successfully bootstrapped release-please with 15 tags (aligning api-client versions to match the API at 0.35.0), confirmed the system produces clean changelogs, and shipped a working /health version endpoint with full OpenAPI spec coverage and unit tests via PR #429.

repo: release-please generates changelogs from the entire commit history when no prior tags exist — bootstrap tags must be created manually on the pre-phase commit to establish a baseline

The health endpoint is manually defined in generate-openapi.ts rather than auto-discovered because HealthController depends on TypeOrmHealthIndicator which requires a real DB connection at instantiation

Phase 41 discussion log (41-DISCUSSION-LOG.md line 106) explicitly decided on monotonic (major.minor) versioning for web and desktop apps, but the implementation used semver — this was consciously deferred
api-client versions (both @cipherbox/api-client and cipherbox-api-client) should track the API version since they are tightly coupled
The pr-release-preview.js script was processing merge commits alongside regular commits, causing false fix labels across unrelated packages
openapi.json version was hardcoded as 0.1.0 in both main.ts and generate-openapi.ts — both needed to read from package.json dynamically
release-please extra-files needs jsonpath syntax for nested JSON fields like info.version, not just a plain file path

code.finding: Version was read inline from package.json; refactored to shared src/version.ts module to avoid duplication with health.controller.ts
Path to package.json from health controller requires two levels up (../../package.json from src/health/) vs one level up from src/ — extracted to shared version.ts to avoid this confusion
Health endpoint spec is manually defined here; the version field, error, details, and required fields were missing from the initial manual schema definition
Merge commits must be filtered by checking parents array length (>=2) before processing commits for conventional commit parsing
extra-files entry for openapi.json requires jsonpath format to bump nested info.version field, not just a plain file path

workflow: Using fix: commit prefix triggers patch version bumps via release-please — CI/infra fixes that shouldn't affect versioning should use chore(ci): instead
When squashing commits to change a message, soft reset to the parent of the first branch commit, re-stage, and force push — avoids interactive rebase complications

The GSD quick workflow executor can be interrupted and the implementation done directly with custom commit scopes (feat(api):) when the default executor commit message format won't match project conventions
Cargo.lock updates should be done selectively (cargo update --workspace) rather than full regeneration to avoid pulling in unrelated dependency churn
Auto-merge on GitHub PRs must be explicitly enabled per PR — it does not persist across PRs automatically

friction: Cargo.lock full regeneration pulled in unrelated dependency updates when only updating one crate version — required manual selective update
npm_package_version env var is not reliably set in all execution contexts — requires fallback to reading package.json directly, which also requires careful path resolution based on file location
The GSD executor was interrupted mid-run to change the commit message scope, requiring manual execution of the plan steps
PR auto-merge appeared enabled (user said it was on) but gh api showed autoMergeRequest as null, causing confusion about merge status
Merge commits in PRs caused false positive release label assignments across unrelated packages in the release preview CI script
openapi.json formatting changed (compact vs expanded arrays) between generate runs due to version reading changes, creating noise in diffs
open_items: Web and desktop apps are using semver instead of the agreed monotonic (major.minor) versioning from the phase 41 discussion — consciously deferred but should be revisited
15 bootstrap tags were created but need to be verified that release-please PR #427 now shows a clean changelog with only recent changes
The shared src/version.ts module was created but the transcript ends before confirming tests pass and the commit/push completes for the version.ts refactor
